title: Property Recommendation for Cold-Start Buyers

blueprintSignals.name: Questionnaire answers
blueprintSignals.definition: budget range, bedrooms and preferred area one-hot encoded
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Self-report is imprecise, so treat it as a prior and not a rule

blueprintSignals.name: Early views
blueprintSignals.definition: embedding of the first three viewed homes averaged with decaying weights
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Curiosity clicks are noisy, so weight saves above views

blueprintSignals.name: Item embedding
blueprintSignals.definition: vector from home attributes, images and text trained on engagement
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Needs retraining as the market changes

blueprintSignals.name: Lookalike buyers
blueprintSignals.definition: similarity of early action sequences to established buyers' early sequences
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Sparse in the first sessions, so use it with a small weight

engineFeatures.meaning: the item the user is looking at now
the last few items in the session, in order
share of recent items in each category
recent interaction counts, corrected for popularity
time per item and traversal pattern used to remove non-human sessions

label: For "Property Recommendation for Cold-Start Buyers": Recommend homes to new buyers from a few early actions or a short questionnaire and refine as signals arrive. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Historical logs are dominated by popular homes so offline scores favour popularity.
